title: Loop Detector
description: Given a linked chain described by node values and a next-index array, determine whether following next links eventually revisits a node.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; each next index is -1 or a valid node index.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n node values. Third line: n next indices.
outputFormat: Print YES if the chain contains a cycle, otherwise print NO.
hints: A cycle causes a fast pointer to eventually meet a slow pointer.

examples.explanation: The links end at -1, so no node is revisited.
Following the links from node 2 eventually returns to node 2.
